name: Kimi K3
notes: The upstream generation_config.json publishes max_length=1048576 and the model card documents a 1M-token context plus low/high/max reasoning-effort controls, but neither source publishes a separate recommended output-token budget or sampler settings. This card therefore uses dflash's conservative 32768-token operational ceiling and deliberately omits sampling, complex-problem and explicit tier values instead of attributing invented recommendations to Moonshot. Smaller-context deployments should set an explicit output limit; M1a parity requests use 24 tokens.
